name: Four-seat No-limit Texas Hold'em
description: A fixed four-seat no-limit Texas Hold'em table with blinds, four betting streets, all-ins, side pots, seven-card evaluation, split pots, and private hole cards.

rules.table: Exactly four stable seats receive equal starting stacks. The button rotates clockwise. Small and big blinds are posted before two private hole cards are dealt.
rules.betting: Preflop, flop, turn, and river support fold, check, call, bet, raise, and all_in. A full raise must meet the previous full raise size. A short all-in increases the call amount but does not reopen raising for a player who already acted.
rules.streets: Betting closes when every non-folded, non-all-in player has acted and matched the current wager. The authority burns privately and reveals three flop cards, one turn, and one river.
rules.showdown: Seven-card hand evaluation covers high card through straight flush. Total contributions create a main pot and any number of side pots. Ties split each pot; odd chips move clockwise from the button.
rules.privacy: Only the current Leader stores the complete deal. A Member sees only its own hole cards until showdown, plus public board, stacks, wagers, pot summaries, and action log.
rules.recovery: A Leader change refunds every stack to its hand-start value, discards the private deal, and starts a fresh hand so no hidden card can be reconstructed by a successor.
